record.institution: SACSCOC Regional Public Universities, 5,000–15,000 Total Headcount Segment
record.segment: Public regional universities; 5,000–15,000 total headcount; SACSCOC geography; no SIS or LMS requirement
facts_carried_over: University of Arkansas at Little Rock reported Fall 2025 total enrollment of 8,026 and described retention and student-success initiatives as contributors to growth. Source: UA Little Rock official pages, 2025-09-05 and 2025 institutional quick facts.

LSU Shreveport reported Fall 2025 enrollment of 11,359 and, on 2026-04-09, reported materially improved retention following redesigned student-support systems begun in 2022. Source: LSU Shreveport official news, 2025-11-12 and 2026-04-09.

University of Tennessee at Chattanooga reported Fall 2025 enrollment of 12,060, launched its Strategic Enrollment Plan implementation on 2026-01-13, and set an 80% first-year retention objective by 2030. Source: UTC official news and strategic-plan materials, 2025-09-08 and 2026-01-13.
Murray State University reported Fall 2025 enrollment of 9,932 and first-to-second-year retention of 78%, its highest in five years. Source: Murray State official news, 2025-10-29.
UTC publicly identifies Navigate as its current student-success platform. Source: UTC official Navigate page, accessed 2026-09-03.
Arkansas State University–Jonesboro and Arkansas State University–Mountain Home are excluded by operator constraint as colleague-owned. Source: operator work order, 2026-09-03.
not_verified: CRM/HubSpot ownership for every institution other than the two operator-specified exclusions remains unverified.
Incumbent student-success platform remains unverified for LSU Shreveport, UA Little Rock, and Murray State; Murray State has an older EAB reference that requires current verification.
The researched set is a trigger-led shortlist, not a complete census of every qualifying SACSCOC public regional university.
constraints: Exclude Arkansas State University–Jonesboro and Arkansas State University–Mountain Home.

record.what_this_suggests: Prioritize growth-stage regional publics with an active, measurable retention implementation; UTC is the strongest planning trigger, while LSU Shreveport is the strongest proof-and-expansion trigger.
